note: per-decision controller latency before/after the D23 optimisation (vectorised beam scoring, cached components, precomputed action velocities, per-axis clearance_many)
optimisations: beam scoring computed once per expansion with numpy gathers instead of 85k cell_of calls
free-component labels cached per time node (18 flood fills per plan -> 1 per node)
one-frame action velocities precomputed at import time
clearance_many rewritten per-axis: avoids the (M,N,2) temporary and one reduce pass
future_freedom replaced by a backward DP over the time-expanded graph (O(1) lookups)
verdict: meets the 33.3 ms budget on the measured synthetic and recorded scenarios
formal_caveat: the frozen-config formal run (data/d7-formal-eval.json) happened before this optimisation; the dev 12-seed re-run after it reproduces identical gate outcomes (data/d7-dev-eval-12x2-seeds12-latency.json), which is evidence the change is behaviour-preserving, but a formal re-run would need a formal-v3 config and a documented void of v2
